title: Client Notification: D-3 Deliverable Integrity

fields.to: Client Liaison (SPO), Communications Lead (PIO), Incident Commander (IC), Aviation Safety Officer (ASO)
fields.cc: General Manager (Marguerite Ostrowski), Systems & Cybersecurity Lead (Tomás Reyes)
fields.subject: Formal Notification: UAS-11 Incident – Data Integrity for Deliverable D-3
fields.body:
To: Client Liaison (SPO), Communications Lead (PIO), Incident Commander (IC), Aviation Safety Officer (ASO)

This is a formal notification under HUOG-ISP Section 7.5 regarding the UAS-11 incident. Data for Deliverable D-3 (CP&L-D3) may have been compromised due to a GNSS spoofing and unauthorized command injection incident that occurred between 09:13 and 09:15 on October 22, 2026.

The forensic analysis confirms that the C2 link was compromised via an unauthorized remote session from IP 192.168.100.22, resulting in a change to the aircraft’s home point and flight path. The RTK-1 base (SM-L1) was the first point of compromise, and telemetry data from the 09:10–09:15 window is now under verification.

All data transfers related to Deliverable D-3 are on hold until integrity verification is complete. The next update is scheduled for 14:00. Refer to HUOG-ISP Section 7.5 for full client notification protocol.

This incident does not involve any external client data beyond the CP&L-D3 instrument. No speculation on attacker motives or other client systems is included at this time.
fields.signatureBlock:
Devin Alcott
Incident Commander
RIT UAS Operations Group

instructorNote: This is the formal client notification per HUOG-ISP Section 7.5. The Incident Commander must issue it with the General Manager and ASO as cc. The team must pause all data transfers to the client until verification completes.
